title: Los Angeles security deposit interest ordinance
requirement: A landlord subject to California Civil Code § 1950.5 must pay annual interest on security deposits held at least one year, at either the rate set by the Rent Adjustment Commission or the actual interest earned.
key_value: RAC rate or actual interest earned, annually
coverage_conditions: Landlords subject to California Civil Code § 1950.5 who hold security deposits for tenants; mobile home parks are excluded.

applicability.per_tenancy: Interest accrues only on deposits held at least one year; on termination only a tenant whose deposit was held one year or more may collect unpaid interest.

penalty: Tenant may bring an action to recover the amount owed, including in small claims court.
